title: Genealogies of Issachar, Benjamin, Naphtali, Manasseh, Ephraim, and Asher

questions.question: How many sons did Issachar have?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 7:1 (ESV): "The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four."

questions.question: Who was the father of Joshua (Oshea/Hoshea)?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 7:27 (ESV): "Nun his son, Joshua his son."

questions.question: Who killed the sons of Ephraim (Ezer and Elead)?
options: The men of Gath who were born in the land
questions.correctAnswer: The men of Gath who were born in the land
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 7:21 (ESV): "...whom the men of Gath who were born in the land killed, because they came down to raid their livestock."

questions.question: What was the name of the daughter of Ephraim who built Beth-horon?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 7:24 (ESV): "His daughter was Sheerah, who built both Lower and Upper Beth-horon..."

questions.question: Who were the sons of Naphtali derived from?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 7:13 (ESV): "The sons of Naphtali... the descendants of Bilhah."

questions.question: Who were the sons of Tola?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 7:2 (ESV): "...heads of their fathers' houses... mighty warriors of their generations..."

questions.question: How many troops of the sons of Issachar were there in the days of David?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 7:5 (ESV): "Their kinsmen belonging to all the clans of Issachar were in all 87,000 mighty warriors, enrolled by genealogy."

questions.question: Who was the mother of Machir's wife?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 7:15 (ESV): "And Machir took a wife for Huppim and for Shuppim. The name of his sister was Maacah..."

questions.question: Who had only daughters?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 7:15 (ESV): "...and the name of the second was Zelophehad, and Zelophehad had daughters."

questions.question: What happened to Ephraim after his sons were killed?
options: He mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him
questions.correctAnswer: He mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 7:22 (ESV): "And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him."

questions.question: How many men ready for service were listed for Asher?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 7:40 (ESV): "...The number enrolled by genealogy for service in war was 26,000 men."

questions.question: Who was the father of Ehud?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 7:10 (ESV): "The sons of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud..."

questions.question: Who born to Manasseh by his Aramean concubine?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 7:14 (ESV): "The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his Aramean concubine bore; she bore Machir the father of Gilead."

questions.question: What name did Ephraim give to his son born after the tragedy?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 7:23 (ESV): "...and he called his name Beriah, because disaster had befallen his house."

questions.question: Who were the sons of Asher?
options: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and Serah their sister
questions.correctAnswer: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and Serah their sister
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 7:30 (ESV): "The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and their sister Serah."

key_verse_text: All these were the sons of Asher, heads of fathers' houses, select mighty warriors, chief of the princes.
